        ### Question
        One of the following statements about the epidemiology and prognosis of heart failure is INCORRECT. Point it out

        ### Options
        opa. Between 60 and 70% of patients die in the first 5 years after establishing the diagnosis of heart failure.
opb. The functional situation of the patient with heart failure is the one that best correlates with the expectation of survival.
opc. Diastolic dysfunction predominates in elderly women with a history of chronic hypertension.
opd. Heart failure due to systolic dysfunction is usually observed in male patients with ischemic heart disease.
ope. The prevalence of heart failure is decreasing in the last decade thanks to better control of cardiovascular risk factors.

### Reasoning Chains per Option:
CHAIN: "Between 60 and -> 70%
CHAIN: "The functional situation of the patient with heart failure is the one that best correlates with the expectation of survival" -> "functional status is a key prognostic indicator" -> "better functional status correlates with improved survival" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Diastolic dysfunction predominates in elderly women with a history of chronic hypertension" -> "diastolic dysfunction is common in this demographic" -> "supported by clinical studies" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Heart failure due to systolic dysfunction is usually observed in male patients with ischemic heart disease" -> "systolic dysfunction is more prevalent in men" -> "ischemic heart disease is a common cause" -> 90%
CHAIN: "The prevalence of heart failure is decreasing in the last decade thanks to better control of cardiovascular risk factors" -> "some studies suggest prevalence is stable or increasing" -> "improved management does not necessarily reduce prevalence" -> 75%
